name: Speak-No-Evil Monkey
baseMeaning: A monkey covering its mouth with its hands.
tldr: 🙊 means “I’ve got a secret” or “I’m teasing a reveal,” with playful secrecy rather than a demand for silence.

contextMeanings.meaning: The covered mouth can represent choosing not to say anything for the moment.
🙊 announces that the sender has news but wants to keep the reveal under wraps for now.
contextMeanings.example: i have news but i’m saving the reveal 🙊

contextMeanings.meaning: Paired with something obvious, 🙊 can jokingly suggest that the sender is barely containing an enormous reveal.
contextMeanings.example: shh 🙊 i’m definitely about to overshare

contextMeanings.meaning: In dating chats, 🙊 can be coy and flirty while withholding a personal reveal.
contextMeanings.example: wait until you see who i’m with later 🙊

platformNotes.note: In a private iMessage conversation, 🙊 often works as a one-message pause before a reveal. It suits the playful, coy tone of a friend who has news but is not ready to explain it.
In an Instagram caption or story, 🙊 can introduce a teaser or personal update. It is part of the vocabulary used to make a soft launch feel coy rather than formally announced.

In a TikTok caption or comment, 🙊 can create a quick reveal beat around relationship or personal news. The compact joke works when the surrounding post already gives the audience something to wonder about.
In a Slack channel, 🙊 may come across as theatrical rather than suitably confidential. Use a clear sentence when colleagues actually need to understand that information must not be shared yet.

generationalNotes.note: 🙊 is one of the dominant emojis in Gen Z soft launches. It presents a relationship update as a playful secret instead of declaring everything at once.
Gen X users almost never soft-launch, so they tend to read 🙊 more literally as secret-keeping. The emoji does not necessarily signal a relationship announcement to them.

Older users usually make relationship news more declarative, using explicit couple symbols or captions. 🙊 remains recognizable to them, but its meaning is more likely “keep this secret” than “I am hinting at my partner.”

warnings.title: Reading it as an order to be quiet
warnings.description: 🙊 usually means the sender is withholding their own news, not that everyone else should stop talking. Say “keep this between us” when literal confidentiality matters.

warnings.title: Expecting a relationship announcement
warnings.description: 🙊 can tease a personal update without necessarily meaning a new relationship. If the sender wants to announce a partner, they may choose a couple symbol or a direct caption instead.

seoDescription: What does 🙊 mean? It shows playful secrecy: “I have news but I’m not telling yet,” often used in teasing reveals and soft-launch posts.

longForm.overview:
🙊 is a monkey with both hands over its mouth, but its usual meaning is not literal silence. People send it when they have something to reveal and want to create a playful pause: “I have news, but I’m not telling yet.” The gesture makes the withholding look cute and theatrical rather than secretive or tense.

It often appears in launch posts, where it marks a personal update—often a relationship reveal—as something being teased rather than announced directly. In friend threads, it can mean “between us” or “don’t tell anyone,” though 🤫 is often the less dramatic choice. 🙊 can also be paired with a caption such as “shh 🙊” to perform that secret-keeping bit. The key difference is intent: 🙊 is usually the sender joking about withholding information, not an instruction for everyone else to stop talking.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
Someone sends 🙊 at the exact moment they want to delay a reveal. They may have just teased a trip, a relationship update, or news about someone else, then use the monkey instead of giving the answer. The sender is usually the person holding the information and controlling when everyone gets it. That makes 🙊 feel like a curtain call: pay attention, but wait for my next message.

In a group chat, “shh 🙊” or “don’t tell anyone 🙊” makes the secrecy a joke between sender and group. A launch post can use it to tease a new chapter without announcing every detail. It works because withholding information sounds playful, not because the sender wants everyone to stop talking.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Do not use 🙊 when the information is genuinely confidential and you need people to understand that immediately. A monkey covering its mouth is cute, but it is less direct than a sentence. For sensitive work updates, write “please keep this confidential until Friday,” especially in channels where everyone needs the same information. For literal quiet, say “I’m staying quiet for now” rather than relying on the emoji.

It can also misread in relationship posts. Older users tend to read 🙊 as secret-keeping, while younger users may take it as a playful reveal. If the point is to announce a partner, a couple symbol or sentence may be clearer.
longForm.howToReply:
Match the tease rather than asking what the secret is immediately. If someone sends “got news 🙊,” reply “okay, now I’m curious” or “when are you dropping it?” Sending 🙊 back can keep the bit going, while 🤫 or “between us” makes the confidentiality clearer without needing the reveal. In a soft launch, demanding details may defeat the playful pause the sender chose.

If the emoji lands on your own post, let the other person control the reveal: “okay, I’ll wait” or “one more hint?” If they were waiting for permission to announce something, “go ahead” helps. If the secrecy is confusing, ask whether they mean confidential or simply teasing; 🙊 can do both.

faqs.question: What does 🙊 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: He is probably teasing a reveal or asking you to keep something between you. The emoji alone does not establish romantic interest; wait for the actual information or a more openly affectionate sign.

faqs.question: Is 🙊 flirty?
faqs.answer: It can be coy and flirty, especially in a dating chat, but its main job is withholding a reveal. Use a wink, smirk, or heart when flirtation is the clearer message.

faqs.question: What does 🙊 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: It usually introduces personal or relationship news that the creator is teasing rather than fully explaining. It can also work as a playful “there is more coming” comment.

faqs.question: Why do people use 🙊 instead of 🤫?
faqs.answer: 🙊 makes the secret-keeping more theatrical and cute. In friend threads, many people prefer 🤫 because it more directly suggests “between us” or “don’t tell anyone yet.”

conversationExamples.message: okay i have something to tell you later 🙊
conversationExamples.interpretation: The sender is teasing a personal or romantic reveal while keeping the recipient curious. Respond with “now i’m curious” or let them reveal it when they are ready.

conversationExamples.message: we have a surprise party plan 🙊 don’t let them see this
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is playful group secrecy: the sender has exciting news and wants the recipients to keep quiet. A fitting reply is “my lips are sealed” or “when are we celebrating?”

conversationExamples.message: the details are confidential for now 🙊 i’ll share them when we’re ready
conversationExamples.interpretation: The sender means that the information should not circulate yet, although a clear sentence would be safer in a work channel. Reply with confirmation that you understand the restriction.

conversationExamples.message: grandma’s famous cake is happening saturday 🙊 keep it quiet
conversationExamples.interpretation: The sender is jokingly protecting surprise family news rather than hiding anything serious. An enthusiastic “my mouth is sealed” keeps the family joke going.
On a social post, this can tease a relationship or personal update without fully naming it. Comments may try to solve the reveal, so the poster controls when the details appear.
